name: Lateral shuffle
why: Low sideways shuffles keep you square to the ball across the goal.

setup.space: A strip of floor about 2 m wide. Pick two spots on the floor 2 m apart.
setup.parent: Stand in front like a shooter. Point left or right to start each effort.

steps: Start in a ready stance, hands up in front. Feet wider than the hips, knees bent.
Shuffle sideways to one spot without crossing or clicking the feet together.
Reach the spot with the outside foot, then shuffle back to start.
Walk around and rest for the full time before the next effort.

mistakes.fix: Keep the same low height the whole way.
Push off the trailing foot; keep a gap between the feet.

parent_check: Head stays level, no bobbing up
stop_if: Pain in an ankle, knee, hip or groin
Pain that changes how you move
Chest pain, a racing heartbeat or unusual shortness of breath
Slipping on the floor (fix footwear or surface before going on)

easier.variant: Step-together side steps at walking pace.
easier.use_when: The feet cross or the stance rises.

harder.variant: Shuffle on the parent's point and change direction once in the middle.
harder.move_on_when: Every rep clean two sessions in a row, and the owner approves.
